hooks.command: docker ps --filter name=yaminabe-db --format '{{.Status}}' | grep -q Up || docker compose -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/docker-compose.yml" up -d 2>&1; echo '{}'

if pgrep -f 'next dev.*apps/web' > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo '{}'; else cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && nohup npx turbo dev --filter=web > /dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 3; echo '{"systemMessage":"Next.js dev server started"}'; fi

python3 -c "import sys,json,subprocess;d=json.load(sys.stdin);p=d.get('prompt','');do_start='アプリ起動' in p;r=subprocess.run(['docker','ps','--filter','name=yaminabe-db','--format','{{.Status}}'],capture_output=True,text=True) if do_start else None;running=r and 'Up' in r.stdout;subprocess.run(['docker','compose','-f',sys.argv[1],'up','-d'],capture_output=True) if do_start and not running else None;print(json.dumps({'systemMessage':'Docker起動完了'}) if do_start and not running else json.dumps({'systemMessage':'Docker起動済み'}) if do_start else '{}')" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/docker-compose.yml"
